tools.name: get_mapping_evidence
tools.description: Relevant applied modeled target identities with natural-key Code-style target/source metadata and exact applied Object/Attribute transformations. Context is design evidence, not measured outcomes. Omitted/empty selectors return all eligible records, paged. Continue with cursor only.
tools.output: Shared {items,next_cursor,is_complete,incomplete_object_key} envelope. Singleton variables return one item. Same record shapes as the variable, complete records; incomplete_object_key always null. Oversized indivisible records fail explicitly.

tools.name: get_current_code
tools.description: Current saved Code artifacts and contributing Source System codes, with lifecycle/locks and generated content. Empty means unavailable; no execution success is implied. Omitted/empty selectors return all eligible records, paged. Continue with cursor only.
tools.output: Shared {items,next_cursor,is_complete,incomplete_object_key} envelope. Singleton variables return one item. Same record shapes as the variable, complete records; incomplete_object_key always null. Oversized indivisible records fail explicitly.

tools.name: get_applied_checks
tools.description: Existing Validation Check records, exact typed operator/operand definitions and SQL, lifecycle/locks and Tenant/System/Group/Check natural identities. These are definitions, not execution results. Omitted/empty selectors return all eligible records, paged. Continue with cursor only.
tools.output: Shared {items,next_cursor,is_complete,incomplete_object_key} envelope. Singleton variables return one item. Same record shapes as the variable, complete records; incomplete_object_key always null. Oversized indivisible records fail explicitly.

rules: Optional enablement and invocation; no-input/empty selects all eligible. Frozen prepared values only; no live DB, arbitrary SQL, code execution, ingestion Mapping reader, or downstream dependency inventory. Same-reader cursor restores selection. Unknown keys, changed selector with cursor, and unavailable/oversized results are errors; never silent truncation.
